page.title: Best LiFePO4 Battery with Charger (2026): Redodo 100Ah + 20A charger, and the golf cart kits
page.desc: Researched pick for a LiFePO4 battery with a matched charger: Redodo's 12V 100Ah low-temp battery plus its 14.6V 20A charger, the Redodo 48V golf cart kit, and what to avoid.
page.intro:
Short answer. The best lifepo4 battery with charger is the Redodo 12V 100Ah Trolling Motor Battery ({buy:redodo-12v-100ah-trolling-motor-low-temp}) paired with the Redodo 14.6V 20A LiFePO4 charger ({buy:redodo-14-6v-20a-lifepo4-charger}): 1,280 Wh, a BMS that stops charging below 32°F, and a dedicated 14.6 V charger that refills it from empty in about 5 hours. The most common worry, a new battery that reads 0 V and will not take a charge after its BMS shuts off, is answered by the charger's activation mode, which wakes a protected pack before charging. Together they cost under $320 on 2026-11-06.

If you are converting a golf cart, the Redodo 48V 100Ah Conversion Kit ({buy:redodo-48v-100ah-golf-cart-conversion-kit}) is the only true one-box battery-plus-charger here: 5,120 Wh, a 58.4 V 18 A charger and a 500 A shunt monitor. It was $430 less than the Vatrer 48V 105Ah kit ({buy:vatrer-48v-105ah-club-car-golf-cart-battery-kit}) on 2026-11-06; buy Vatrer instead if you need a UL 2271 listing.

Two honest notes. ECO-WORTHY's 12V 100Ah Bluetooth battery plus its 20 A charger came to about $17 less than the Redodo pair on 2026-11-06, with an app; its charger is a multi-chemistry unit, so you must pick the LiFePO4 mode yourself. Power Queen sells a real single-SKU kit, a 12V 100Ah low-temp battery with a 14.6 V 20 A charger, but we could not read its price today. Amazon prices were not checkable on 2026-11-06.

page.after:
What owners complain about

  • "It reads 0 V and won't charge." The single most common thread. A LiFePO4 BMS disconnects after a deep discharge, and many chargers refuse to start unless they see battery voltage. The fix is a charger with an activation or 0 V mode, which the Redodo 20 A and Vatrer kit chargers have. A plain lead-acid charger often cannot do this.
  • Lead-acid chargers never finish the job. A 12 V lead-acid profile tops out near 14.4 V, drops to float, and may not restart bulk charging until the pack is nearly empty. Owners report batteries stuck at 70–99%. Use a 14.6 V LiFePO4 charger.
  • Charging below freezing. Charging a cold lithium cell plates the anode and the damage does not heal. Both Redodo batteries above cut charging off at 32°F; the self-heating version warms itself first instead of just refusing.
  • 10 A chargers are slow. A 100 Ah pack takes about 10 hours on 10 A and about 5 hours on 20 A. The 20 A charger is the sweet spot for 100 Ah; go to 40 A only for 200 Ah and up.
  • Fan noise and heat. Most 20 A bricks have a small fan that owners call loud, and the case runs warm. Charge in a garage or outside, not next to a bed.

Which one by need

  • RV, boat or small solar, 12 V: the Redodo 12V 100Ah trolling motor battery with the Redodo 14.6V 20A charger. If you want an app readout, step up to the Redodo 12V 100Ah Group 24 Bluetooth battery ({buy:redodo-12v-100ah-group-24-bluetooth-low-temp}) with the same charger.
  • Winter camping or a boat stored outside: the Redodo 12V 100Ah Self-Heating battery ({buy:redodo-12v-100ah-self-heating-lifepo4}) with the 20 A charger. The charger powers 100 W heating pads until the cells pass 41°F, then charging begins on its own.
  • Golf cart, everything in one box: the Redodo 48V 100Ah Conversion Kit. Pick the Vatrer 48V 105Ah kit when a UL 2271 listing is required.
  • Lowest price with Bluetooth: ECO-WORTHY's 12V 100Ah Bluetooth battery plus its 20 A charger, if you are comfortable selecting the LiFePO4 mode on a multi-chemistry charger.

Not recommended

  • Any 5 A or 10 A charger for a 100 Ah pack unless you have all night and never run the battery flat.
  • Multi-chemistry chargers left in AGM or lead-acid mode. They charge to the wrong voltage and float when lithium should rest. One Slickdeals owner reported a 20 A unit stuck at 99% on a 100 Ah ECO-WORTHY pack.
  • Redodo's 12V 320Ah lead-to-lithium kit for this search. It bundles an inverter, not an AC battery charger, and is more than most shoppers asking for a battery with charger need.
